test_AutoConfig_from_pretrained: test AutoConfig.from_pretrained to load a config from a HuggingFace model shortcut like google-bert/bert-base-uncased
test_AutoConfig_for_model: test AutoConfig.for_model to get the config class for a model type string like roberta
test_AutoConfig_register: test AutoConfig.register to register a custom config class with a unique model type name
test_dynamic_config_trust_remote_code: test loading a dynamic config from a remote repo using trust_remote_code=True with AutoConfig.from_pretrained
test_config_missing_model_type: test that AutoConfig.from_pretrained raises a ValueError when config.json is missing the model_type key
